hero.title: Your team's knowledge,
hero.subtitle: Centralize your documentation, ask questions in natural language, and get precise answers grounded exclusively in your own content. No hallucinations, only your knowledge.

features.title: Everything your team needs to manage knowledge
features.subtitle: From document creation to AI-powered insights, DocuMind provides a complete platform for team knowledge management.

workspaces.title: Structured Workspaces
workspaces.desc: Create organized workspaces with nested folders and documents. Keep your team's knowledge centralized and easy to navigate.

qa.title: AI Q&A on Documents
qa.desc: Ask questions in natural language and get precise answers sourced exclusively from your indexed documents with full citations.

summaries.title: Smart Summaries
summaries.desc: Generate structured summaries of any document with one click. Save time by letting AI extract the key information.

search.title: Semantic Search
search.desc: Find documents by meaning, not just keywords. Our vector-based search understands the intent behind your queries.

roles.title: Role-Based Access
roles.desc: Fine-grained permissions with Viewer, Editor, Admin, and Owner roles. Control exactly who can read, edit, or manage content.

isolation.title: Data Isolation
isolation.desc: Complete multi-tenant isolation ensures your data never mixes with other organizations. AI only accesses your workspace content.

howItWorks.title: From documentation to intelligence in 4 steps

create.title: Create & Organize
create.desc: Set up your workspace, create folders, and write documents using our rich text editor.

index.title: Automatic Indexing
index.desc: Every saved document is automatically chunked and indexed using vector embeddings for AI-powered retrieval.

ask.title: Ask Questions
ask.desc: Open the AI assistant, ask questions in natural language, and receive precise sourced answers.

generate.title: Generate & Simplify
generate.desc: Auto-summarize documents, simplify complex content, or generate new documents from a description.

ai.title: AI that only knows what you know
ai.subtitle: Unlike general-purpose AI, DocuMind's assistant exclusively uses your own documents as its knowledge source. No hallucinations, no external data contamination.

qa.title: Contextual Q&A
qa.desc: Ask anything about your documents and get answers with exact source citations

summaries.title: One-Click Summaries
summaries.desc: Generate structured summaries of long documents instantly

simplify.title: Content Simplification
simplify.desc: Rewrite complex documentation in plain, accessible language

generate.title: AI Document Generation
generate.desc: Describe what you need and let AI draft a structured first version

chatDemo.question: How does the authentication system work in our API?
chatDemo.answer: Based on the REST API Authentication Guide, the system uses JWT tokens for stateless authentication. The flow is: user submits credentials, server validates with bcrypt, JWT token is generated and returned.

security.title: Enterprise-grade security by design
security.subtitle: Your data privacy is our priority. Every aspect of DocuMind is built with security-first principles.

isolation.title: Multi-Tenant Isolation
isolation.desc: Complete data separation between workspaces. No data leakage, ever.

auth.title: JWT + bcrypt Auth
auth.desc: Industry-standard authentication with hashed passwords and secure tokens.

permissions.title: Granular Permissions
permissions.desc: Role-based access control with per-document permission overrides.

scoped.title: Scoped AI Context
scoped.desc: AI only accesses documents from your workspace. No cross-org data mixing.

rateLimit.title: Rate Limiting
rateLimit.desc: Protection against brute force with automatic account lockout after 5 attempts.

audit.title: Audit Trail
audit.desc: Full version history and activity tracking for compliance and accountability.

cta.title: Ready to transform how your team manages knowledge?
cta.subtitle: Join teams who trust DocuMind to centralize their documentation and make it intelligently searchable.

footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js, PostgreSQL + pgvector, and OpenAI.
